description: This file defines the EntityFieldMap class, which is a final class extending EntityConditionListBase<EntityExpr>. It models an unordered collection of condition expressions based on a map of fields, used to generate SQL-style conditions for entity queries by linking field comparisons with logical join operators. The class provides methods for constructing such conditions from a map or key-value pairs, and for accessing the contained field information.

classes.name: EntityFieldMap
classes.description: A final class representing a condition based on a map of fields; it allows creation of complex comparison expressions for entity queries.
